mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates and signals aggressive monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 131,000 jobs signals strengthening labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the threshold is breached.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 131,000, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in industrial production and housing starts indicates robust manufacturing and residential sector activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through joint economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST exceed their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-crisis recovery regimes, rising consumer price inflation above 2.0% annually signals improving economic conditions and reduced recession risk, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods during post-crisis recovery when CPIAUCSL rises above 2.0% annually, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 13,000 billion chained dollars indicates strong aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days when the threshold is breached.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 13,000 billion, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index reflects expanding manufacturing output, correlating with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (above 9.0%) combined with persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) signals monetary policy response to labor market weakness, preceding positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market distress with accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery regimes, rising housing starts above 600,000 units indicate strengthening residential demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods during housing market recovery when HOUST rises above 600,000 units, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
